description: Verify a Base USDC transaction or check order status with its download_token. Returns a direct ZIP URL, actual archive file manifest and receipt only after settlement. Pending, mismatched or replayed payments never unlock a pack.

download_token.description: Order-specific capability from signed_deliverable_zip_url, required if tx_hash is omitted.

tx_hash.description: Settled Base Mainnet transaction hash; omit when checking status with download_token.
